note: Large Alberta Parks campground in spruce forest along the Bow River, off Hwy 1X about 30 km east of Canmore, run by Cedar & Spruce Campgrounds. Loops C and E line the river; loop A is unserviced. Some power posts share a breaker with the neighbouring site. Water (taps, showers, flush toilets) runs mid-May to season's end; showers for a fee. The dump station is at the adjacent Willow Rock campground. Amphitheatre with interpretive programs, playground. --Claude
